notes.title: Next Fest Patch!
notes.content:
Steam next fest is just around the corner!

This Demo update brings many important changes


 Artstyle and visual improvements
 New grapple and grab section for the Tutorial
 Farting Monsters
 New trailer and screenshots for store page
 Many bugs squashed
 Farting Monsters
 UI and Text overhaul
 Main menu interaction and visual overhaul!
 Intro cutscene improvements
 Did I mention Farting Monsters?
 And many more changes!


Hope this will give you as much enjoyment as it has given me!

// Jesper

notes.title: Demo update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello!

Demo Patch 1.1 brings a few new things and changes to some features

Changes

 Grapple swinging should now work a bit different. It helps you get up a lot more now.
 Modified visuals to look a bit cleaner and less foggy.


New Features


 Added catapults that can launch player and monsters.
 Added Floating pink blocks that can be used to help with traversal.
 Added More bouncing beds and movable bouncing beds.
 Added truck obstacle that drives through some of the roads.
 Added birds that you can shoot and grapple swing from


There are a ton of smaller changes but hopefully will this patch make the game a bit better than it was before!
